messages:
Ivy (CS): Marco from Aurora Finance says AP won't raise the PO unless the billing entity matches their subsidiary and the approval doc shows the pricing breakdown they received in enablement. Can we move fast?
Zoe (AM): Which subsidiary do they need?
Marco (Customer Finance): Aurora Therapeutics Ltd (VAT: GB12A34567). They also asked that the stub include seat counts, monthly rate, and prorated amount for mid-term add-on. Vendor code AUR-900.
DocuSign Bot: Alert — envelope id 3c9d2b1a flagged: billing_entity == "Aurora Group" (no subsidiary).
Hassan (Ops): We can either fix envelope metadata (longer) or produce a one-page approval stub PDF for AP to attach. What's the target timeline?
Ivy (CS): Customer wants PO issued by EOD tomorrow to avoid service interruption. Short path preferred.
Lina (Legal): Quick legal checklist: add sentence "This approval is provided for procurement routing only and does not amend the Agreement." Include signer name/title/email and PO number placeholder. For totals < $200k we can accept scanned signature as exception if uploaded to Box with audit note.
Zoe (AM): Renewal total after prorate is 98,400 so wet-scan acceptable. Offer three options to Marco: corrected DocuSign envelope, emailed PDF stub they attach, or scanned wet-sign.
Marco (Customer Finance): PDF stub emailed to ap@aurora.tech is our preference. Please include vendor code AUR-900 and contact finance@redwood.com for verification.
Hassan (Ops): Drafting stub now. Will include: base seats 120 @ $0.50/token (kidding) — actually base seats 120 @ $600/mo, prorate for +15 seats $2,700, support add-on $1,500, total $98,400. Also adding term end date 2027-03-01 and reference Order Form dated 2026-02-20.
Ivy (CS): Also capture enablement feedback: customer requested clearer line item for "support response SLA" on future invoices. Put that into the renewal notes for Product.
Hassan (Ops): Stub uploaded to Box: /Approvals/aurora/6187654321-approval-stub.pdf and DocSend: https://docsend.com/view/aurora-6187654321-stub
Lina (Legal): I'll log the exception approval in the customer file and note that scanned signature accepted for this case.
Zoe (AM): Sending email to Marco now with three options and attaching the PDF. I'll ask AP to confirm when they attach to the PO.
Marco (Customer Finance): Got it, emailing AP now. Please cc ap@aurora.tech. We'll notify when PO number issued.
DocuSign Bot: Recommendation — update default billing entity mapping for envelope id 3c9d2b1a to include subsidiary Aurora Therapeutics Ltd.
Hassan (Ops): Created ticket OPS-8456 to update billing metadata mapping and add a validation check to surface subsidiary choices during envelope creation.
Ivy (CS): Noted the enablement feedback and opened FR-223 for Product to add invoice line clarifications.
Marco (Customer Finance): AP attached the stub and issued PO# AUR-2026-332. Scanned copy will be uploaded. Thanks for the fast turn. :thumbsup:
Zoe (AM): Awesome — marking renewal executed. Will follow up on OPS-8456 status in next sprint.
Ivy (CS): Closing thread. Reopen if finance reports any mismatch between PO and invoice.
